title: Espinho Relocation
description: Relocation planning: Orlando FL to Espinho, Portugal. Target move: January 2027. Both are PT citizens.
instructions:
## Espinho Relocation Project

This project tracks all planning and execution for relocating Wagner and Leo from Orlando, FL to Espinho, Portugal.

### Key Parameters
- **Target Date:** January 2027
- **Origin:** Orlando, FL, USA
- **Destination:** Espinho, Portugal (Aveiro district)
- **Status:** Both are Portuguese citizens — no visa required
- **Familiarity:** High — family in area, multiple prior visits

### Workstreams
1. Housing (rental/purchase via Idealista and other sources)
2. Healthcare (SNS public system + private insurance options)
3. Finance & Taxes (US-PT tax treaty, banking, NIF, cost of living)
4. Legal & Documents (Cartão de Cidadão, concelho registration, driving)
5. Shipping & Logistics (moving company, what to bring vs buy)
6. Leo's Care (age-specific needs, support services in Espinho)
7. Daily Life (transportation, utilities, community, language)
8. Timeline & Milestones (countdown to Jan 2027)

### Constraints
- Budget: TBD (needs research)
- Leo's health and comfort are top priority
- All research must be verified against current 2026 PT regulations and costs
